integrity_policy: Known upstream LFS SHA256 values are provenance only; bootstrap verifies exact file sizes and pinned cache revision, without rehashing 190GB.
generation_policy: No Turbo LoRA, implicit quantization, sparse attention, or sampler caching is added by bootstrap. Actual generation acceptance must be recorded separately.
